# Badge Studio

> An editable browser studio for badges with personality. Humans and coding agents share the same canvas.

## Start

- Live editor: https://badge-studio.crafter.run/design
- Human and agent guide: https://badge-studio.crafter.run/docs#agents
- Source: https://github.com/crafter-station/badge-studio
- Companion skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crafter-station/badge-studio/main/skills/badge-studio/SKILL.md
- Install CLI: npm install --global badgio
- Install skill: npx skills add crafter-station/badge-studio --skill badge-studio
- Load the versioned workflow: badgio skills get core

Ask for a photo or local image path, then use badgio doctor to check dependencies.
Ask before installing missing agent-browser. Offer ai-cli only for requested image transformations.
Read badgio skills get design for editable typography, both faces, layers, graphics and materials.

## Persistent preview

badgio studio start opens the operating system's default browser.
With an available built-in browser panel, start with --no-open --json and open data.url there.
Keep that process and the same preview tab alive for all iterations.
Only one tab owns the connection; do not open its private session URL in another browser for verification.

badgio studio tools --url "$BADGE_STUDIO_URL" --json
badgio studio call badge_inspect --url "$BADGE_STUDIO_URL" --params '{"section":"state"}' --json

The local connection uses the same editor tools and validation even without native WebMCP.
Use agent-browser for visual verification and connect to the existing preview when that browser supports it.
Do not replace the user's preview with agent-browser's separate automation browser.

## Browser tools

The /design page registers native WebMCP tools when document.modelContext is available:
badge_inspect, badge_edit, badge_set_participant, badge_set_image, badge_get_image, badge_view, badge_library, badge_export, badge_cancel.

Discover the actual tool metadata before invocation. Start with badge_inspect section state. Each edit requires the expectedRevision from current state or the last receipt. Invalid or stale changes are rejected. Edits share the UI's validation, locks and undo. To cancel, inspect operation.id and invoke badge_cancel with operationId. Completed writes and downloads are not rolled back.

With agent-browser:
agent-browser --session badges --webgpu open https://badge-studio.crafter.run/design
agent-browser --session badges webmcp list badge_inspect --json
agent-browser --session badges webmcp invoke badge_inspect --params '{"section":"state"}' --json

## Generation boundary

The coding agent reasons about layouts. The web does not call an LLM or accept API keys.
Optional image generation/transformation runs externally with ai-cli and the user's AI Gateway credentials.
The agent can explicitly export an image, transform it, inspect it, and import its bytes.
Model reference support and transparent output vary. Gateway credits are separate from the coding agent subscription.

Shared profile/photo data and saved designs stay in this browser. Exported JSON has no embedded photos.
For an offline workflow, use badgio styles list, badgio design create and badgio design validate, then import the JSON and its images in the editor.
